Side A — Logic & Build

Technical Events

Four missions for the ones who'd rather ship code than talk about it. Bring a team, a laptop, and a plan B.

MISSION FILE — 01

Hackxora

Hackathon
  • Build innovative solutions.
  • Solve real-world problems.
  • Develop a working prototype.
  • Showcase creativity and technical skills.
  • Judged on idea, implementation, innovation, presentation & feasibility.
MISSION FILE — 02

Inquisia

Paper Presentation
  • Present innovative technical ideas.
  • Explore emerging technologies.
  • Demonstrate research and knowledge.
  • Showcase originality and innovation.
  • Judged on idea, implementation, innovation, presentation & Q&A.
MISSION FILE — 03

Netwarz

Coding
  • Solve challenging coding problems.
  • Test logic and programming skills.
  • Apply algorithms and data structures.
  • Tackle networking & cybersecurity challenges.
  • Judged on output, implementation, exception handling & complexity.
MISSION FILE — 04

Enigma

UI / UX
  • Design creative digital interfaces.
  • Solve a given design challenge.
  • Focus on usability and user experience.
  • Showcase creativity and design thinking.
  • Create attractive and functional solutions.
Two Sides, One Web

Build it, or outsmart it.

Side B — Mind & Instinct

Non-Technical Events

Think. Guess. Survive. Five rapid-fire games built on nerve, memory and pure instinct — no code required.

GAME FILE — 01

Crack the Prompt

AI Prompting
  • Create effective AI prompts.
  • Solve creative prompt challenges.
  • Test AI interaction skills.
  • Think creatively and strategically.
  • Accuracy and creativity matter.
GAME FILE — 02

Signal Hunt

Clue Hunting
  • Find hidden clues and signals.
  • Test observation and reasoning.
  • Decode information.
  • Connect clues to find answers.
  • Challenge your detective skills.
GAME FILE — 03

Ctrl + Guess

Guessing Game
  • Guess answers from clues.
  • Test observation and intuition.
  • Challenge your general knowledge.
  • Think fast and respond accurately.
  • Compete through fun guessing rounds.
GAME FILE — 04

The Heist

Mystery / Puzzle
  • Solve mystery-based challenges.
  • Follow clues and crack puzzles.
  • Use teamwork and strategy.
  • Make smart decisions.
  • Complete the mission and escape.
GAME FILE — 05

Whizper

Listening / Memory
  • Listen carefully to hidden messages.
  • Decode whispered clues.
  • Test concentration and memory.
  • Communicate effectively with your team.
  • Accuracy and quick thinking are key.
